Hi Jamie,

I came across Ballast, your debut collection from Drunk Muse Press, and was struck by how your poems have grown out of life in Connemara, from your Fool for Poetry winning chapbook Corona Connemara & Half a Crown to your residency at Brigit's Garden. A first full collection after that kind of run feels like a real milestone worth celebrating.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
